coala-runtime now runs and installs packages in more images.

## Images without `python`, with old pip, or with an externally managed Python

The Python executor resolves `python` or `python3` at run time, so images that ship only `python3` work. pip settings are passed as environment variables, which older pip ignores instead of failing, and installs are allowed into an externally managed Python (PEP 668).

## R images without BiocManager

The R executor installs BiocManager first when the image lacks it, so Bioconductor packages install on plain R images.
